text:
marie: FYI customer saw duplicate charges after a short burst of 429s when their client rotated credentials. Two identical POSTs landed ~180ms apart.
tony: Do they use Idempotency-Key?
marie: Yes on sync paths, but the async streaming helper in their codebase doesn't set it.
peter: That mismatch is rough. Also traces show immediate retry on 429 while refresh token was ongoing.
marie: So recreate: request -> 429 -> client starts refresh -> client retries immediately -> refresh completes, new token sent -> both requests accepted.
tony: Sounds like a refresh/race + missing idempotency. We should add a small debounce when refresh is active and ensure SDK streaming helpers always attach idempotency for side-effectful calls.
elllen: +1 on parity. Node has a simple refresh mutex, but Python sampleapp lacks it. deps-bot: Ticket created: DX-3174 "streaming idempotency + refresh debounce".
marie: Short-term mitigation we can send to customer: 1) enable server-side idempotency enforcement, 2) apply a client-side mini-lock around refresh (delay retries 150-300ms), 3) upgrade SDKs when patches land.
ton y: Proposed minimal guard snippet for sampleapp (JS): ```js
let refreshLock = false;
async function send(req) {
  if (refreshLock) await sleep(rand(120, 280));
  return await attemptSendWithJitter(req);
}
async function refresh() { refreshLock = true; await doRefresh(); refreshLock = false }
```
peter: We should also add metric "sdk.retry_during_refresh" and expose it in Console so teams can detect this pattern quickly.
marie: I'll patch the sampleapp to assert idempotency header presence in dev mode and add a note in onboarding checklist about server enforcement. Tony, can you own Node/Go PRs? Peter, can you do Python sample + docs?
tony: I can do Node + Go this week.
peter: I'll take Python and docs next week.
deps-bot: PRs opened: node-sdk#525, go-sdk#312, python-samples#144. CI queued.
elllen: Also consider adding an opt-in SDK config: safe_replay=true which turns on the refresh guard and idempotency enforcement for customers who have dangerous side-effects.
marie: Good idea. We'll keep default false to avoid surprising latency for low-risk apps. Send me the customer note draft and I'll review.
deps-bot: Incident record created: dup-replay-2026-04-02.
marie: Thanks team. We'll monitor the metric after rollouts. :thumbsup:
